products.name: Moisturizing Gel-Cream
products.summary: Gel-cream moisturizer containing niacinamide, Ceramide NP, cholesterol and green tea extract. BYOMA describes it as oil-free and fragrance-free.
products.usage: Brand directions: apply 1–2 pumps after cleansing and serum, morning and evening.
products.notes: Full ordered INCI is from authorized retailer Ulta. The manufacturer page groups ingredients by function rather than listing them in formula order; it was used to corroborate product identity and directions. Tri-Ceramide Complex describes three lipid components, not three separately listed ceramides.

products.name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%
products.summary: Water-based serum with disclosed 10% niacinamide and 1% zinc PCA. The manufacturer positions it for shine and uneven texture.
products.usage: Brand directions: apply a few drops to the face morning and evening; stop if irritation occurs.
products.notes: Ingredient studies using 2–5% niacinamide do not verify this 10% finished product or establish that a higher concentration works better.

products.name: Relief Sun: Rice + Niacinamide
products.summary: Cream sunscreen labeled SPF50+ PA++++ with niacinamide and rice-derived ingredients. Previously named Relief Sun: Rice + Probiotics.
products.usage: Follow the regional package directions; apply generously before sun exposure and reapply as directed, especially after sweating or swimming.
products.notes: The brand states that the Rice + Probiotics rename does not change the formula. This is the EU/global filter formula, not the separate US Daily Relief sunscreen. SPF is a finished-product label claim, not inferred from ingredient papers.

products.name: Hydrating Facial Cleanser
products.summary: Non-foaming rinse-off cleanser containing glycerin, three ceramides and sodium hyaluronate. The brand lists no added fragrance.
products.usage: Brand directions: wet skin with lukewarm water, massage gently and rinse.
products.notes: Rinse-off exposure differs from leave-on moisturizer trials. Verify the package because the brand updates ingredient lists.

products.name: Cicaplast Baume B5+
products.summary: Barrier balm containing 5% panthenol, dimethicone, glycerin, shea butter and madecassoside.
products.usage: Brand directions: apply to face, body or lips as needed, avoiding the eye contour.
products.notes: UK B5+ formula, manufacturer formula code N70011474/1. This is not the US B5 balm or the separate SPF50 variant.

products.name: Ceramide Barrier Serum
products.summary: Milky serum containing five ceramides, beta-glucan, glycerin, jojoba oil and squalane.
products.usage: Brand directions: apply after cleansing and before moisturizer.
products.notes: Current manufacturer reformulation removes lactic acid, adds beta-glucan and rebalances the oil blend. The older brand FAQ describes a previous formula. No hyaluronic acid is listed. The disclosed hero-ingredient group percentage is not a concentration for each ceramide.

products.name: Gentle Facial Cleanser
products.summary: Soap-free rinse-off facial cleanser with glycerin and two cleansing surfactants. The manufacturer states it contains no botanical extracts or essential oils.
products.usage: Brand directions: apply to wet skin, lather, rinse and pat dry.
products.notes: Rinse-off cleanser; leave-on glycerin trial results do not establish this product’s hydration performance.

products.name: Daily Facial Moisturizer
products.summary: Daily facial moisturizer containing squalane, glycerin, hyaluronic acid and five ceramides.
products.usage: Brand directions: apply as needed, day or night.
products.notes: Non-SPF daily moisturizer; do not confuse it with the separate Vanicream SPF30 sunscreen. Individual ingredient concentrations are not disclosed.

products.name: SKIN PERFECTING 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant
products.summary: Leave-on liquid exfoliant with disclosed 2% salicylic acid and green tea.
products.usage: Brand directions: apply after cleansing and toning; do not rinse. Start slowly and follow the label’s daytime sunscreen directions.
products.notes: The US manufacturer page lists Camellia Oleifera without a plant-part suffix; retain the source wording. Clinical studies of other salicylic-acid vehicles do not establish efficacy for this finished product.

products.name: 100% Plant-Derived Squalane
products.summary: Single-ingredient, water-free squalane serum. The manufacturer identifies its squalane source as sugar cane.
products.usage: Brand directions: apply a few drops daily or as needed after water-based treatments.
products.notes: One ingredient is the full manufacturer INCI, not an abbreviated list. No product-specific clinical efficacy is inferred.
